description:
84asana is a free classical yoga guide for beginners.

• 13 foundational asanas with step-by-step instructions, benefits, and contraindications
• Complete warm-up sequence — Arrival & Centering, 15 Joint Rotations, and Surya Namaskar
• 40-minute Dhyana meditation practice with breath awareness and Brumadhyam focus
• No login, no account, no payment — completely free

Ask anything: "List me all asanas", "Show me Tree Pose", "Take me through the warm-up", or "Guide me through meditation".

defaultPrompt: Take me through the warm-up sequence
